TOU per 闽发改规〔2023〕8号 (2023-11-28, eff. 2024-01-01, valid 5 years; official text on fgw.fujian.gov.cn; still cited by every notice in the window): 峰 10-12, 15-20, 21-22; 谷 0-8; others 平; 7-9月 尖峰 11-12, 17-18. Float on 代理购电价格 only: 峰 +58%, 谷 −63%, 尖峰 +80%. No holiday/深谷 variant.
